stem: For how long is a child with chickenpox generally considered infectious?

options.text: Only after the rash has fully crusted
From a few days before rash onset until all lesions have crusted
Only during the fever before the rash
Only on the first day of the rash

explanation: Chickenpox is infectious from before the rash appears until lesions have crusted. This timing is important for school exclusion and contact management.

preRepair.stem: Child has a rash with some vesciles, some papules, some pustules. She has come from overseas 2 months ago. She was playing with her cousins on the weekend. Mum wants to know how long the infectious period is:

options.text: From 2 weeks before the rash appeared until all lesions crust
From a few days before the rash appeared until all lesions crust
From 2 weeks before the rash until all the lesions had cleared
From a few days before the rash until all lesions cleared
